title: fix(kimi): strip injected goal-command prefix from session titles
context:
Kimi's ACP agent titles a session from the raw first user message. When
that message is CCC's /goal-command compatibility shim, the injected
instruction text landed as the session's title/first_message instead of
the user's actual goal. Reuses the same prefix-stripping already applied
to replayed messages.

Fixes CCC-920.
 What changed: added _strip_ccc_kimi_goal_prefix.
